# Diffusion, viscosity and forcing {#sec-ch09}

This chapter covers every source term snapy adds to the stage increment besides the flux divergence and constant
gravity: the forcing loop that parses, installs and sums them; user stage forcings written in TorchScript; the
Coriolis force; the isotropic viscosity and heat conduction, with their face coefficient at walls and their
optional $x_1$ profiles; prescribed heating and cooling; the bottom relaxations of temperature, velocity and
composition; and the sponge layers. All of them are explicit and act through one increment, and every native
module reads the same stage-entry state, so their order does not change the result. Constant gravity is the first module of the same loop; it and its work
are @sec-ch06; sedimentation is @sec-ch10-sed; the tracers that ride the dry-air part of these sources are
@sec-ch10-tracer. Two entries record code that is present but never runs: the plume forcing and the turbulence
closure, which is not built.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch09-deps
#| fig-cap: "Dependency map of the schemes of this chapter. Solid arrows read 'is part of', dashed arrows 'hands its dry-air increment to', dotted arrows 'needs'. Every native module runs inside the forcing loop; the wall face coefficient and the $x_1$ profiles are parts of the viscosity and conduction module; the forcing loop and the user stage forcings both hand their dry-air density change to the passive tracers; the wall coefficient needs $x_1$ boundary functions with a recorded wall name, and the composition relaxation needs kintera's thermodynamics."
#| fig-alt: "Directed graph of twelve boxes: user stage forcings, forcing loop and dry-air tracers on top; Coriolis, viscosity and conduction, heating and cooling, bottom relaxation and sponge layers in the middle; x1 coefficient profiles, wall face coefficient, named x1 walls and kintera thermo at the bottom, joined by solid, dashed and dotted arrows."
#| echo: false

```

| scheme | switch | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Forcing loop (@sec-ch09-framework) | `forcing:` keys | none | n/a | `test_forcing` |
| User stage forcings (@sec-ch09-user) | `set_user_stage_forcings` | none | user | `test_stage_forcing_dry_tracer_python` |
| Coriolis (@sec-ch09-coriolis) | `coriolis` | off | exact pointwise | `test_forcing` |
| Viscosity and conduction (@sec-ch09-viscosity) | `diffusion` | off | 2 (1 at walls) | `test_diffusion` |
| Wall face coefficient (@sec-ch09-wallcoef) | automatic | on at named walls | 2 | `test_diffusion` |
| $x_1$ coefficient profiles (@sec-ch09-x1profile) | `nu_scale_x1`, `kappa_scale_x1` | none | 2 | `test_diffusion_x1_scale` |
| Heating and cooling (@sec-ch09-heating) | `body-heat`, `top-cool`, `bot-heat` | off | exact pointwise | `test_forcing` |
| Bottom relaxation (@sec-ch09-relax) | `relax-bot-temp`, `-velo`, `-comp` | off | 1 in time | `test_forcing` |
| Sponge layers (@sec-ch09-sponge) | `top-sponge-lyr`, `bot-sponge-lyr` | off | 1 in time | `test_forcing` |
| Plume forcing (@sec-ch09-plume) | `plume-forcing` | never installed | n/a | none |
| Turbulence (@sec-ch09-turbulence) | none | not built | n/a | none |

: The schemes of this chapter. "Order" is the spatial order of the discrete operator, or the order in time for the
